summary: Pinnacle Food Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing that Wencai Pan ceased as CFO effective June 1, 2026, due to termination under his employment agreement, not due to any disagreement. The board appointed Dr. Yunhao Chen as CFO, who previously served as an independent director. Dr. Chen has CFO experience at Massimo Group and Dogness International, leading IPOs and SEC compliance. The filing includes a press release and executive services agreement. This is a routine CFO change with no special-situation catalyst; no takeover, restructuring, or capital event is involved. What to watch: smooth transition and any future strategic moves.
